overview_description.description:
At Haber, we drive the future of industrial automation. With a focus on manufacturing industry, our portfolio includes automation services for chemical dosing across different applications at paper mills, sugar mills, distilleries, breweries, independent institutions, and mining.

Haber was established on February 28, 2017 by Vipin Raghavan and Priya Venkat in Maharashtra, India.

about_short_description.short_description: Haber is an integrated platform for process, utilities and water systems driving visibility.

product.name: eLIXA® Platform
product.description: A cloud-based AI-driven platform for real-time monitoring, control, and automation of process, utilities, and water systems in industrial plants.

product.name: Kaiznn™ Deckle Matching Software
product.description: An AI-driven advanced planning and scheduling system that optimizes deckle matching to reduce trim loss and improve production efficiency in paper mills.

product.name: Robotic Sampling System
product.description: An automated sampling system that replaces manual sampling to provide accurate, real-time process monitoring data.

product.name: Lime Mud Dewatering Program
product.description: A program that optimizes moisture content in lime mud to reduce fuel consumption and improve lime kiln operations in pulp mills.

product.name: Utilities Process Optimization Solutions
product.description: AI-driven solutions for optimizing cooling tower and boiler operations to improve asset integrity and reduce water, energy, and chemical usage.
